sections.text:
Zbog održavanja 12. jesenjeg planinarskog maratona na Fruškoj gori, 17.10.2026. godine (SUBOTA), privremeno se skraćuje trasa linije broj 74- NOVI SAD-POPOVICA u periodu od 07.00 do 18.00 časova.

Polasci iz Novog Sada, saobraćaju do raskrsnice Ulica Fruškogorski put-Majdanska. 

Polasci za Novi Sad, obavljaju se od navedene raskrsnice, po redu vožnje.

text_translations.en:
Due to the holding of the 12th Autumn Mountaineering Marathon on Fruška Gora, October 17, 2026. (Saturday), the route of line number 74 - NOVI SAD-POPOVICA is temporarily shortened from 07:00 to 18:00.

Departures from Novi Sad run to the intersection of Ulica Fruškogorski put-Majdanska. 

Departures for Novi Sad are made from the mentioned intersection, according to the timetable.

title: Obaveštenje - Izmena režima saobraćaja u Futogu - "FUTOŠKA KUPUSIJADA 2026"

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve (broj:IV-34-6778/2026) određuje se privremena izmena trase autobuskih linija broj 53 i 55,  za vreme održavanja manifestacije ''FUTOŠKA KUPUSIJADA 2026'' u FUTOGU. Izmenjen režim saobraćanja važi od  16. oktobra 2026.godine (od 1200h) do 18.  oktobra 2026. godine.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads (number: IV-34-6778/2026), a temporary change in the route of bus lines number 53 and 55 is determined during the "FUTOŠKA KUPUSIJADA 2026" event in FUTOGO. The modified traffic regime is valid from October 16, 2026 (from 1200) to October 18, 2026.

sections.text: LINIJE BROJ 53 i 55 MENJAJU TRASU KRETANJA I SAOBRAĆAJU:

text_translations.en: LINES NUMBER 53 and 55 CHANGE THE ROUTE AND TRAFFIC:

sections.text: - Polasci iz Novog Sada za Futog saobraćaju redovnom trasom do Futoga- raskrsnice Ulica Cara Lazara, Braće Bošnjak i Svetozara Markovića, zatim nastavljaju Ulicom Svetozara Markovića, desno Partizanskom, desno Branka Radičevića, levo Ulicom Rade Kondića i dalje saobraćaju redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: - Departures from Novi Sad to Futog take the regular route to Futogar - the intersection of Ulica Cara Lazara, Braća Bošnjak and Svetozar Markovića, then continue along Ulica Svetozara Markovića, right Partizanska, right Branko Radičevića, left Ulica Rade Kondića and continue along the regular route.

sections.text: -Polasci iz mesta, u naznačenom periodu, saobraćaju istom-izmenjenom trasom.

text_translations.en: -Departures from the city, in the indicated period, operate on the same-altered route.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase otvaraju se privremena stajališta u oba smera (Ulici  S.Markovića-Industrijska i Branka Radičevića-Povrtarska), kao i stajališta iz pravca Novog Sad neposredno posle raskrsnice S.Markovića-B.Bošnjaka-C.Lazara. Takođe, koriste se postojeća autobuska stajališta Linije-56 (par-benzinska pumpa).

text_translations.en: On the changed part of the route, temporary stops will be opened in both directions (S.Markovića-Industrijska and Branka Radičevića-Povrtarska Streets), as well as stops from the direction of Novi Sad immediately after the intersection of S.Markovića-B.Bošnjak-C.Lazar. Also, the existing bus stops of Line-56 (steam-gas station) are used.

title_translations.en: Notice - Change of the traffic regime in Futog - "FUTOSHKA KUPUSIJADA 2026"

title: Linije 6, 11A, 11B – Privremena izmena trase u Ulici Marka Miljanova

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve o zatvaranju dela Ulice Marka Miljanova, zbog radova na toplovodu od 13. 10. godine privremeno će biti izmenjene trase autobuskih linija broj 11A i 11B, a od 14. 10. trasa linije broj 6.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads on the closure of a part of Marka Miljanova Street, the routes of bus lines 11A and 11B will be temporarily changed from 10.13., and from 10.14.

sections.text: Predviđeno je da radovi traju do 16. 11. 2026. godine.

text_translations.en: It is planned that the works will last until November 16, 2026.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn right from Filipa Višnjić Street to Venizelosova Street, right past Kvantaš to the roundabout, left to Marka Miljanova Street, right to Belgrade Quay and continue on the regular route.

text_translations.en: Buses will continue straight on Belgrade Quay and after the road-railway bridge will turn left into Venizelosova Street, right into Temerinska Street, left into Partizanska Street, left into Kisačka Street, right onto Jaše Tomić Boulevard and continue along the regular route.

text_translations.en: Buses will turn left from Jovan Cvijić Street into Temerinska Street, right into Venizelosova Street, right past Kvantaš to the roundabout, left into Marko Miljanova Street, right onto Begradski Quay and continue along the regular route.

text_translations.en: ON THE MODIFIED PART OF THE ROUTE, A TEMPORARY STOP WILL BE USED IN TEMERINSKA STREET, IMMEDIATELY AFTER THE LEFT TURN FROM JOVANA CVIJIĆA STREET.

sections.text: Autobusi na liniji 5 od 9. 10. (od 20:00 časova) ponovo saobraćaju redovnom trasom nakon završetka radova u Avijatičarskoj ulici.

text_translations.en: Buses on line 5 from October 9 (from 8:00 p.m.) are running again on the regular route after the completion of the works in Avijatičarska street.

title: Ukidaju se vanredni polasci do i od Železničke stanice Petrovaradin

sections.text: Nakon otvaranja železničkog stajališta na Rumenačkom putu i rasterećenja Železničke stanice Petrovaradin, raskinut je ugovor između „Srbijavoza“ i JGSP „Novi Sad“ o organizovanju besplatnih vanrednih polazaka autobusa na relaciji Šafarikova ulica – Železnička stanica Petrovaradin.

text_translations.en: After the opening of the railway stop on Rumenački put and the relief of Petrovaradin Railway Station, the contract between "Srbijavoza" and JGSP "Novi Sad" on organizing free emergency bus departures on the route Šafarikova Street - Petrovaradin Railway Station was terminated.

sections.text: Shodno tome, od 12. oktobra ukidaju se vanredni direktni polasci autobusa sa redovnog stajališta „Petrovaradin – Železnička stanica“, u Preradovićevoj ulici, do terminala u Šafarikovoj ulici u centru Novog Sada (oba smera).

text_translations.en: Accordingly, as of October 12, extraordinary direct bus departures from the regular "Petrovaradin - Railway Station" stop in Preradovićeva Street to the terminal in Šafarikova Street in the center of Novi Sad will be canceled (both directions).

sections.text: Putnici i dalje mogu da koriste redovne polaske na linijama 3, 9, 9A, 60, 61, 62 i 63 za dolazak do Železničke stanice Petrovaradin.

text_translations.en: Passengers can still use regular departures on lines 3, 9, 9A, 60, 61, 62 and 63 to get to Petrovaradin Railway Station.

title_translations.en: Extraordinary departures to and from Petrovaradin Railway Station are cancelled

title: Linije 11A, 11B - Privremena izmena trase od 30.9. u Ulici Maksima Gorkog

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve,  određuje se privremena izmena trase autobuskih linija broj 11a, 11b, zbog izvođenja radova u Ulici Maksima Gorkog. Izmenjeni režim saobraćanja linija važi od 30. 9. do završetka radova. Autobusi na ovim linijama menjaju trasu kretanja na sledeći način:

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, a temporary change in the route of bus lines number 11a, 11b is determined, due to the performance of works in Maksima Gorko Street. The modified traffic regime of the lines is valid from September 30 until the completion of the works. Buses on these lines change their route as follows:

sections.text: LINIJA 11A (smer Ž.stanica-Bolnica-Liman-Ž.stanica)

text_translations.en: LINE 11A (direction Train Station-Hospital-Liman-Train Station)

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Bulevar cara Lazara/Stražilovska autobusi nastavljaju pravo Bulevarom cara Lazara, produžavaju Kejom žrtava racija do raskrsnice sa Ulicom Maksima Gorkog  i dalje nastavljaju već izmenjenom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Tsar Lazar Boulevard/Strazilovska, buses continue straight along Tsar Lazar Boulevard, continue along Quay of the victims of raids to the intersection with Maksima Gorki Street, and continue along the already changed route.

sections.text: LINIJA 11B (smer Ž.stanica- Liman-Bolnica-Ž.stanica)

text_translations.en: LINE 11B (direction Railway Station - Liman - Hospital - Railway Station)

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Kej žrtava racija/Maksima Gorkog autobusi autobusi saobraćaju pravo Kejom žrtava racija, zatim Bulevarom cara Lazara do raskrsnice sa Stražilovskom ulicom i dalje nastavljaju redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Raid Victims' Quay/Maxim Gorki, buses run straight along Raid Victims' Quay, then along Tsar Lazar Boulevard to the intersection with Stražilovska Street and continue on their regular route.

sections.text: AUTOBUSI NA LINIJI 11A KORISTE PRIVREMENA STAJALIŠTA NA BULEVARU CARA LAZARA -ISPRED TEHNOLOŠKOG FAKULTETA I PRIVREMENO STAJALIŠTE NA KEJU ŽRTAVA RACIJE-MAKSIMA GORKOG.

text_translations.en: BUSES ON LINE 11A USE TEMPORARY STOPS AT CARA LAZARA BOULEVARD - IN FRONT OF THE FACULTY OF TECHNOLOGY AND A TEMPORARY STOP AT QUAY VICTIM OF THE RAID - MAXIM GORKO.

title_translations.en: Lines 11A, 11B - Temporary route change from September 30. in Maksima Gorki Street

title: Linija 4 produžena do železničkog stajališta Rumenački put

sections.text: Od 7. oktobra  trasa linije 4 produžava se do Rumenačkog puta, čime je građanima omogućena direktna veza javnim prevozom do železničkog stajališta Rumenački put.

text_translations.en: From October 7th, the route of line 4 is extended to Rumenački put, which enables citizens to have a direct connection by public transport to the railway stop Rumenački put.

sections.text: Autobusi na liniji će sa Bulevara oslobođenja nastavljati Bulevarom Jaše Tomića, Rumenačkom ulicom i Rumenačkim putem do železničkog stajališta Rumenački put. Ista trasa koristi se i u suprotnom smeru.

text_translations.en: Buses on the line will continue from the Boulevard of Liberation to the Boulevard of Jaša Tomić, Rumenački street and Rumenački put to the railway stop Rumenački put. The same route is used in the opposite direction.

sections.text: Na produženom delu trase koriste se postojeća stajališta, a uvedeno je i novo stajalište u okviru parking zone železničkog stajališta Rumenački put.

text_translations.en: On the extended part of the route, the existing stops are used, and a new stop was introduced within the parking zone of the Rumenački put railway station.

sections.text: Sa izmenom trase promenjen je i naziv linije, koja sada saobraća pod nazivom LIMAN 4 – CENTAR – Železnička stanica (Rumenački put).

text_translations.en: With the change of the route, the name of the line was also changed, which now runs under the name LIMAN 4 - CENTAR - Railway station (Rumenački put).

sections.text: Produžavanjem linije 4 unapređuje se povezanost nove Železničke stanice sa centralnim gradskim područjem, kao i sa drugim važnim gradskim pravcima. Linija povezuje više značajnih odredišta, među kojima su Futoška pijaca, Bulevar Mihajla Pupina i područje Novosadskog univerziteta.

text_translations.en: The extension of line 4 improves the connection of the new railway station with the central city area, as well as with other important city routes. The line connects several important destinations, including the Futoška market, Mihajla Pupina Boulevard and the area of ​​the University of Novi Sad.

sections.text: Izmena trase doprinosi boljoj dostupnosti javnog prevoza za građane koji koriste železnički prevoz, a dodatno unapređuje prevoznu uslugu za stanovnike Avijatičarskog naselja i mogućnosti putovanja ka Univerzitetu.

text_translations.en: The route change contributes to better availability of public transport for citizens who use rail transport, and additionally improves the transport service for the residents of Avijatičarski settlement and the possibility of traveling to the University.

sections.text: Pored linije 4, do novog železničkog stajališta Rumenački put građani mogu da koriste i linije 5, 14, 41, 42 i 43.

text_translations.en: In addition to line 4, citizens can also use lines 5, 14, 41, 42 and 43 to reach the new railway stop Rumenački put.

title_translations.en: Line 4 extended to the railway stop Rumenački put

title: Linija 5 - Privremena izmena trase u Avijatičarskoj ulici

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 1. 9. do završetka radova u Avijatičarskoj ulici određuje se privremena izmena trase autobuske linije broj 5 .

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, from September 1 until the completion of the works in Avijatičarska street, a temporary change of the route of bus line number 5 has been determined.

sections.text: Smer sa Temerinskog puta

text_translations.en: Direction from Temerinsky road

sections.text:
Od raskrsnice Rumenački put/Avijatičarska autobusi saobraćaju pravo do kružnog toka gde se polukružno okreću i vreme do sledećeg polaska izdržavaju na stajalištu „Rumenački put-Kružni tok“(stajalište linija 10, 14, 14s, 15, 41, 42, 43).

Na izmenjenom delu trase autobusi će kao svoje poslednje stajalište koristiti redovno stajalište „Rumenački put-Avijatičarska“(stajalište linija 10, 14, 14s, 15, 41, 42, 43)

text_translations.en:
From the intersection of Rumenački put/Avijatičarska, buses run straight to the roundabout, where they turn around and wait until the next departure at the "Rumenački put-Kružni tok" stop (line 10, 14, 14s, 15, 41, 42, 43).

On the changed part of the route, buses will use the regular stop "Rumenački put-Avijatičarska" as their last stop (stop lines 10, 14, 14s, 15, 41, 42, 43)

sections.text: Smer sa Avijatičarskog naselja

text_translations.en: Direction from Aviaticarski settlement

sections.text: Autobusi linije 5 po redu vožnje saobraćaju od stajališta „Rumenački put-Kružni tok“ i kao prvo  stajalište sa Avijatičarskog naselja koriste redovno stajalište „Rumenački put-Avijataičarska“ (stajalište linija 5, 10, 14, 14s, 15, 41, 42 i 43), odakle nastavljaju da saobraćaju redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: According to the timetable, buses of line 5 operate from the stop "Rumenački put-Kružni tok" and as the first stop from Avijatičarski settlement they use the regular stop "Rumenački put-Avijataičarska" (stop of lines 5, 10, 14, 14s, 15, 41, 42 and 43), from where they continue to operate on the regular route.

title_translations.en: Line 5 - Temporary route change in Avijatičarska street

title: Linija 52 – Privremena izmena trase u Veterniku

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 6. do 26. oktobra  privremeno će biti izmenjena trasa autobuske linije broj 52 zbog radova u Ulici vojvode Bojovića u Veterniku.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, from October 6 to 26, the route of bus line number 52 will be temporarily changed due to works in Vojvode Bojovića Street in Veternik.

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Tome Maksimovića/Kralja Petra prvog autobusi će skretati levo u Ulicu kralja Petra prvog, na kružnoj raskrsnici izlaziće na prvom izlazu u Ulicu kralja Aleksandra do Školske ulice, skretai levo u Školsku ulicu i na prvom stajalištu „Veternik-Škola“ (nekada polazno stajalište linije 52) čekaće se vreme do polaska za Novi Sad.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Toma Maksimović/Kralj Petar the first, the buses will turn left into Kralja Petar the First Street, at the roundabout they will take the first exit into Kralja Aleksandra Street to Školska Street, turn left into Školska Street and at the first stop "Veternik-Škola" (formerly the starting stop of line 52) they will wait until their departure for Novi Sad.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koristiće se stajališta drugih linija.

text_translations.en: Stops of other lines will be used on the changed part of the route.

sections.text: Polasci za Novi Sad započinjaće sa stajališta „Veternik-Škola“, odakle će autobusi dalje saobraćati redovnom trasom kretanja.

text_translations.en: Departures for Novi Sad will start from the "Veternik-Škola" stop, from where buses will continue to run on the regular route.

text_translations.en: See the map of changes HERE

title: Linije 10, 17, 42js, 55js – Privremena izmena trase u Industrijskoj ulici (ZONA JUG)

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, od 17. do 29. septembra 2026. godine privremeno će biti izmenjena trasa autobuskih linija broj 10, 17, 42JS, 55JS zbog radova u Industrijskoj ulici, od raskrsnice kod „Super VERA“ do raskrsnice kod „Šnajder Elektrik d.o.o“ .

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, from September 17 to 29, 2026, the route of bus lines number 10, 17, 42JS, 55JS will be temporarily changed due to works in Industrijska Street, from the intersection at "Super VERA" to the intersection at "Schnejder Elektrik d.o.o."

sections.text: LINIJA 10 (oba smera)

text_translations.en: LINE 10 (both directions)

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Partizanska/Industrijska autobusi će produžavati pravo do raskrsnice sa Sentandrejskim putem, skretati levo pored NIS-ovih pumpi, levo na Put Novosadskog partizanskog odreda, saobraćati do raskrsnice sa Industrijskom ulicom i dalje redovnom trasom. U suprotnom smeru koristiće se ista, izmenjena trasa.

text_translations.en: At the intersection Partizanska/Industrijska, buses will continue straight to the intersection with Sentandrejska Street, turn left past the NIS pumps, left onto the Novi Sad Partisan Detachment Road, drive to the intersection with Industrijska Street and continue along the regular route. In the opposite direction, the same, modified route will be used.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koristiće se postojeća stajališta drugih linija.

text_translations.en: Existing stops of other lines will be used on the changed part of the route.

sections.text: LINIJA 17 (oba smera)

text_translations.en: LINE 17 (both directions)

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Sentandrejski put/Partizanska autobusi će nastavljati pravo pored NIS-ovih pumpi i od Ulice Teodora Mandića saobraćati pravo redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Sentandrejski put/Partizanska, buses will continue straight past the NIS pumps and from Ulica Teodora Mandić drive straight along the regular route.

sections.text: U suprotnom smeru autobusi će saobraćati istom trasom - Sentandrejskim putem do Kisačke ulice i dalje produžavati pravo redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: In the opposite direction, buses will travel along the same route - Sentandrejski pute to Kisacka street and continue straight along the regular route.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koristiće se postojeća stajališta drugih linija.

text_translations.en: Existing stops of other lines will be used on the changed part of the route.

sections.text: LINIJE 42JS, 55JS (oba smera)

text_translations.en: LINES 42JS, 55JS (both directions)

sections.text: Na raskrsnici Partizanska/Industrijska autobusi će produžavati pravo do raskrsnice sa Sentandrejskim putem, skretati levo pored NIS-ovih pumpi i od Ulice Teodora Mandića nastavljati predviđenom, redovnom trasom za „zonu Sever“.

text_translations.en: At the intersection of Partizanska/Industrijska, buses will continue straight to the intersection with Sentandrejska Street, turn left past the NIS pumps and from Ulica Teodora Mandić continue along the planned, regular route for the "Zone Sever".

sections.text: U suprotnom smeru autobusi će saobraćati istom trasom - Sentandrejskim putem do Kisačke ulice, skretati desno u Partizansku ulicu i dalje nastavljati redovnom trasom.

text_translations.en: In the opposite direction, buses will travel along the same route - Sentandrejski pute to Kisacka Street, turn right into Partizanska Street and continue on the regular route.

sections.text: Na izmenjenom delu trase koristiće se postojeća stajališta drugih linija.

text_translations.en: Existing stops of other lines will be used on the changed part of the route.

title: Linije 5, 10 APT, 14, 41, 42, 43 – Privremeno ukidanje stajališta RUMENAČKA – RADNIČKO IGRALIŠTE

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske Uprave za saobraćaj i puteve Grada Novog Sada, od 9. 9. 2026. godine do završetka radova privremeno će biti ukinuto autobusko stajalište Rumenačka – Radničko igralište zbog izvođenja građevinskih radova. Navedeno stajalište koriste linije broj 5, 10 APT, 14, 41, 42, 43 – smer ka Sajlovu).

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads of the City of Novi Sad, from September 9, 2026, until the completion of the works, the bus stop Rumenačka - Radničko igraštet will be temporarily closed due to construction works. The mentioned stop is used by lines number 5, 10 APT, 14, 41, 42, 43 - direction to Saylov).

title: Linije 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 i 71vmč – Privremena izmena trasa u Ulici Maksima Gorkog

sections.text: U skladu sa rešenjem Gradske uprave za saobraćaj i puteve, određuje se privremena izmena trase autobuskih linija broj 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 i 71vmč  zbog izvođenja radova na rekonstrukciji kolektora kanalizacione mreže  u Maksima Gorkog, od Stražilovske ulice do Sutjeske ulice u Novom Sadu. Izmenjen  režim saobraćnja linija važi u periodu od 7. 9. do 20. 11. 2026. godine.

text_translations.en: In accordance with the decision of the City Administration for Traffic and Roads, a temporary change in the route of bus lines number 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 and 71vmč is determined due to the performance of works on the reconstruction of the sewer network collector in Maksim Gorko, from Stražilovska Street to Sutjeska Street in Novi Sad. Izmenjen  režim saobraćnja linija važi u periodu od 7. 9. do 20. 11. 2026. godine.

title_translations.en: Lines 12, 60, 61, 62, 63, 64, 69 and 71 vmč - Temporary change of routes in Maksima Gorki Street

sections.text:
Autobusi JGSP „Novi Sad“ od 1. septembra saobraćaće po novom redu vožnje, koji u odnosu na letnji red vožnje podrazumeva veći broj polazaka.

O vremenskim korekcijama polazaka korisnici usluga mogu da se informišu u rubrici RED VOŽNJE, kao i putem aplikacije NSMART, te na prodajnim mestima preduzeća.

Od 1. septembra ponovo će na snazi biti polasci koji su u redu vožnje označeni kao „đački“.

text_translations.en:
From September 1, JGSP "Novi Sad" buses will operate according to a new timetable, which, compared to the summer timetable, implies a greater number of departures.

Service users can be informed about time corrections of departures in the section RED VOZNJE, as well as through the NSMART application and at the company's sales points.

From September 1, the departures marked as "pupil" in the timetable will be valid again.
